description: The bar chart compares the performance gain (%) of three different models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two supervision conditions: Strong Supervision and Weak Supervision. The vertical axis represents Performance Gain in percentage, ranging from 0 to 30 with increments of 5. The horizontal axis lists the three models. For each model, two bars are displayed side by side: a darker blue bar with diagonal stripes representing Strong Supervision and a lighter blue bar representing Weak Supervision. In all three cases, the Strong Supervision bar is significantly taller than the Weak Supervision bar. Specifically, GPT-4o shows a performance gain of approximately 24% under Strong Supervision and about 5% under Weak Supervision. Claude-3.5-Sonnet achieves a gain of around 9% with Strong Supervision and roughly 3.5% with Weak Supervision. Qwen2-72B-VL demonstrates a performance gain of approximately 15% under Strong Supervision and about 5% under Weak Supervision. Overall, the chart illustrates that Strong Supervision consistently leads to higher performance gains across all models compared to Weak Supervision.
